subject: Boundary sealing evidence and snapshot disposal plan
messages:
From: Anya Petrov <anya.petrov@silverbank.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: security@silverbank.com
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 16:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Evidence for region pin & snapshot disposal plan

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. Our security team needs a concise package to verify that SilverBank's Dedicated cluster will be pinned to eu-west-1 with no cross-region replication, and that snapshots and backups can be located, tracked, and disposed of on a tenant-bound schedule. Specifically we need:

- A manifest of existing snapshots and their storage locations (object keys or snapshot ids).
- The retention policy applied to tenant snapshots and any cross-region DR replication exemptions (if any).
- A deletion/disposal playbook for snapshots (what triggers deletion, who signs off, artifact of deletion).
- A short attestation that metadata, logs, and backups for our tenant will not be retainable outside the pinned region.

Can you provide these artifacts and estimated timelines? We are trying to close this item for our auditors by Nov 5.

Regards,
Anya Petrov
Head of Cloud Security
SilverBank

Attachment: none (initial request)
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Anya Petrov <anya.petrov@silverbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence for region pin & snapshot disposal plan

Hi Anya,

Thanks — below is a concise package to start with. We've scoped this specifically for your Dedicated tenant binding in eu-west-1. Please let us know if you need additional raw artifacts.

Summary (high level):
- Region pin: Tenant is pinned to eu-west-1; control plane and serving nodes for the dedicated pool are anchored to AZ pairs in that region. No scheduled cross-region replication for persistent snapshots.
- Snapshot manifest: attached file snapshot_manifest.csv lists snapshot_id, creation_time, storage_bucket (eu-west-1 only), size.
- Disposal playbook: our standard tenant-bound snapshot disposal flow is: retention expiry -> automated soft-delete (30d) -> automated purge on 30th day -> operator verification and final purge log. For SilverBank we propose shortening soft-delete to 7 days (per your ask) and will produce logs for each purge event.
- Audit evidence: included region_binding_attestation.docx and a sample wipe_proof.zip containing an example purge log and S3 delete markers.

Key details and exceptions:
- Disaster recovery: we do maintain cross-region DR runbooks, but we do NOT proactively replicate tenant snapshots across regions. Cross-region replication is allowed only under an explicit DR activation (documented and auditable) and requires a signed runbook entry.
- Temporary artefacts: ephemeral cache and KV caches are ephemeral and not part of persistent snapshots. KV caches are not exported to persistent storage outside eu-west-1.
- Key management: all keys for your tenant are bounded to the tenant KMS key in eu-west-1. If you opt for a customer-managed key in your tenant, we will record the key ARN in the attestation.

Next steps and asks for us to produce final artifacts:
1) Confirm you want the soft-delete shortened to 7 days (default is 30).
2) Confirm if you require signed, notarized attestation (DocuSign) or a company-signed PDF is sufficient.
3) If you need DR runbook copies for auditors, we will redact operational IPs and provide the redacted document.

Attachments (stubs):
- pin_request_form.pdf (PDF, 14KB) — signed request we use to lock tenant pinning.
- snapshot_manifest.csv (CSV, 9KB) — current snapshot inventory (object keys anonymized).
- region_binding_attestation.docx (DOCX, 12KB) — draft attestation for signature.
- wipe_proof.zip (ZIP, 42KB) — sample purge log + delete markers.

I'll loop Karhtik to confirm the purge log format and Marissa to prepare the DocuSign envelope if you want notarized attestation.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
